title: Welcome to Yeh Mera India
excerpt: A new stage for stories rooted in India and ideas shaped for tomorrow.
content:
Yeh Mera India brings literature, theatre, culture and responsible experiments with artificial intelligence into one living archive. This is a place for long-form writing, dramatic work, field notes and conversations about the future.

Every post begins with a human point of view. Technology helps us research, translate, illustrate and reach more readers, but the author's voice remains at the centre.
